releases.notes:
- The in-game config screen checks every value while typing: numbers outside their range and unknown choices are marked red, and Done is disabled until every value is valid, listing the invalid ones.
- Every value can be reset to its default with the ↺ button next to it, or all at once with Reset all. Nothing is saved until Done.
